name: com.midmanstudio.allthingsjiggle
displayName: All Things Jiggle - Bone Jiggle Physics
description: Jiggle physics for bone chains: hair, tails, ears, cloth strips and chests. Add a JiggleChain to the first bone and a manager simulates every chain once a frame with Burst jobs, or with the dependency-free Rust core (jiggle_core) behind a C interface, or with a managed C# reference kernel. The Rust and managed kernels give the same bits. Standalone and game-agnostic.
